question: To which revilers of Śiva and the Kula tradition must the teaching never be given?
premises: Slandering the Kula Bhairava is prohibited
The goddess is addressed as witness
inference: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Śiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
uncertainties: kulabhairave may refer to the deity or to the tradition; taken as Kula Bhairava
plain_english: O goddess, not to one who reviles Śiva, nor to a slanderer of the Kula Bhairava.
